briefdescription.para: Hilbert-function-driven early termination helper used by F4GB to skip degrees the user-supplied Hilbert series predicts hold no new basis elements.

detaileddescription.para: Constructed with the source FreeModule and a RingElement* hf encoding the expected Hilbert series. setDegree(d) advances the controller to degree d and exposes nRemainingExpected(), the number of basis-element insertions the series still predicts at that degree. addMonomial(a, comp) is called for each newly minimal monomial and decrements the count; when the count hits zero the driver can skip the rest of the degree.
